points: Yirmiyahu mocks the idols people make with their own hands and then serve. Were our ancestors really that foolish?
Rav Yuval Cherlow: the pull of avodah zarah is a god made to fit our needs. A "feel-good" God who only helps and never makes demands is also a form of idolatry.
One pasuk is in Aramaic, the language of exile, to give the people the words to answer those pushing them to serve idols. We too must equip our kids before sending them off.
"Shfoch chamascha al hagoyim," which we say at the Seder, comes from here.
The Radak: even with all our flaws, we are still Your people, so pour Your anger on the nations attacking us, not on us.
